title: Q-EXP-d2c5497d: close the autonomous-pr gap with a measured change
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every rnd pass
**Done check:** grep:ops/executor-log.jsonl::"result": "pr-opened"
**Prediction:** pageviews_7d >= baseline within 336 h
**Status:** open

Experiment from R&D finding `gap:autonomous-pr`.
Hypothesis: 2 competitors evidence 'agent opens, checks and merges its own pull request'; building it should move the metric
Metric: pageviews_7d. Ship the smallest change the done check proves, then compare the metric against its baseline in doctrine/growth.json; a miss reverts the change and lowers the finding's priority.
